payload.classification_rule: Ranks describe the strongest cited external evidence for the exact configuration, not technology readiness, economic viability, SCPN implementation maturity, signal admissibility, physical-phase qualification, CONTROL admission, actuation authority, or machine-protection authority. Facility-owner claims remain labelled by source kind; adjacent configurations never inherit evidence.

configurations.rank_basis: A commissioned accelerator-driven D-T neutron source documents beam and neutron diagnostics; this is laboratory fusion output, not a power-reactor demonstration.

reference_systems.name: Institute for Plasma Research 14 MeV neutron generator

configurations.rank_basis: The cited reactor proposal analyses colliding energetic populations in an FRC but does not document an exact integrated colliding-beam reactor experiment.
JET documents integrated D-T fusion observations; ITER separately documents diagnostics under development for reactor-like conditions.
A high-beta magnetic-cusp experiment reports time-resolved energetic-electron confinement using hard-x-ray diagnostics; no integrated fusion-power device is established.
Experimental dense-plasma-focus devices document pulsed fusion-neutron output and associated diagnostics, without demonstrating power conversion.
C-2W documents an integrated FRC experiment with a broad diagnostic suite and real-time control inputs, but not a power-conversion demonstration.
The facility-owner report describes integrated FRC merging, compression and diagnostic observations, but lacks peer-reviewed reactor-level qualification and portable public data.
The IAEA source describes conceptual plasma-core, blanket and neutronics analyses rather than an integrated fusion-fission hybrid experiment.
Published GDT experiments document confinement and stability studies on an integrated gas-dynamic mirror, without fusion-power conversion.
A gridded IEC neutron source documents stable neutron production and calibrated imaging use; this is a neutron-source result, not net-energy evidence.
LHD provides an integrated superconducting heliotron experiment with documented diagnostics and data acquisition.
NDCX documents compressed ion-beam and warm-dense-matter target diagnostics relevant to ion-driven ICF, not an integrated igniting target experiment.
OMEGA operates a direct-drive experimental platform and a broad calibrated diagnostic programme, without a cited direct-drive ignition observation.
Fast- and shock-ignition research documents integrated target experiments and dedicated diagnostics, but no cited ignition-scale energy-gain demonstration for this branch.
NIF ignition experiments provide peer-reviewed integrated fusion observations supported by x-ray, neutron, gamma and imaging diagnostics.
LDX documents integrated high-beta dipole plasmas and a calibrated multichannel density interferometer; the cited facility is historical.
MagLIF experiments on Z document thermonuclear fusion observations and multi-diagnostic stagnation measurements, without power conversion.
Peer-reviewed liquid-liner experiments demonstrate controlled liner shaping and compression, not an integrated fusion-output system.
PLX documents formation and diagnostics of a spherical liner from 36 plasma jets; an integrated magnetized target and fusion output are not established by the cited result.
The WB-8 experiment documents improved energetic-electron confinement in a high-beta cusp supporting one Polywell premise, not an integrated fusion-output device.
A commissioned impact platform and UKAEA-reviewed target campaign document shock diagnostics and fusion-compatible particle detections, but not reactor-level gain.

reference_systems.name: First Light Fusion gas-gun target platform

configurations.rank_basis: Sandia records an electron-beam ICF programme and accelerator development that pivoted to particle beams before an integrated ignition demonstration.
RFX-mod2 builds on integrated RFP operation and documents upgraded magnetic, electrostatic, Thomson, x-ray, neutron and imaging diagnostics under development.
FuZE reports sustained neutron production coincident with diagnosed plasma conditions and later dedicated EUV spectroscopy.
WHAM reached first plasma and entered scientific operation with high-field mirror magnets and reactor-relevant heating development.
MAST Upgrade is an integrated spherical-tokamak experimental programme with a documented diagnostic suite; no cited D-T fusion-output result applies to this configuration.
SSPX documents sustained spheromak operation and time-resolved particle diagnostics; the cited programme is historical and did not demonstrate power conversion.
Wendelstein 7-X is an operating integrated stellarator with approximately 45 documented diagnostics and long-pulse diagnostic engineering.
GAMMA 10 documents an integrated tandem-mirror plasma and calibrated VUV/x-ray diagnostics, without a fusion-power demonstration.
Scylla theta-pinch experiments document integrated plasma operation and calibrated x-ray spectroscopy; the cited platform is historical.
ORNL records integrated ATF torsatron operation and diagnostic development; the programme ended in 1991.
Sandia documents long-running integrated Z-pinch experiments and fusion-oriented high-energy-density operation, but this source is not an exact fusion-output qualification for generic Z-pinch.
